messages.content: Translate each English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Preserve meaning, names, scripture references, and unit order. Do not add explanations or content. Output JSON only: {"book_code":"JASHER","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"source_ref":"1:1","text_ar":"..."}]}. Return exactly one row for each input source_ref.

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"text":"And Lamech the father of Noah, died in those days; yet verily he did not go with all his heart in the ways of his father, and he died in the hundred and ninety-fifth year of the life of Noah.","source_ref":"5:19","verse":19,"chapter":5},{"text":"And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy years, and he died.","source_ref":"5:20","verse":20,"chapter":5},{"text":"And all the sons of men who knew the Lord, died in that year before the Lord brought evil upon them; for the Lord willed them to die, so as not to behold the evil that God would bring upon their brothers and relatives, as he had so declared to do.","source_ref":"5:21","verse":21,"chapter":5},{"text":"In that time, the Lord said to Noah and Methuselah, Stand forth and proclaim to the sons of men all the words that I spoke to you in those days, peradventure they may turn from their evil ways, and I will then repent of the evil and will not bring it.","source_ref":"5:22","verse":22,"chapter":5},{"text":"And Noah and Methuselah stood forth, and said in the ears of the sons of men, all that God had spoken concerning them.","source_ref":"5:23","verse":23,"chapter":5}]}
